verdict.rationale: Lium documents a create-pod toggle that puts a Jupyter notebook on the pod, which covers the Jupyter half of the story in roughly one step. Nothing in the evidence shows a VS Code or Cursor remote-connect flow, and the docs don't say how the notebook is opened or reached. missing for 10: IDE (VS Code/Cursor) one-step connection, documentation of how the Jupyter notebook is accessed (URL/auth), independent or hands-on corroboration.
